svg.aria-label: Chatbots are most confident when they’re making things up. So confidence is worse than guessing at spotting lies. Reading its internals: 0.988. (0.254, 0.5 = guessing; halluscope · AUROC on HaluEval, 4,000 answers). None of the 6 published backdoor detectors I tested caught WaNet. A hidden-trigger attack that made every one of them do worse than a coin flip. (0 / 6, detectors that worked; deadbolt · 102 models, 540 blind scans). The model I forked was quietly training toward the wrong target. Its loss still went down, so nobody noticed. One wrong line made it aim 2× too high. (2×, too high, silently; nanoDLM · divided by mask.sum() instead of B·T). Memory that consolidates gets sharper with age, not noisier. Over a simulated year, You2 went from 0.50 to 1.00 and stale facts never resurfaced. (1.00, retrieval precision; you2 · nightly summarize, version, and decay).
